title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 178
paragraphs: Next after the Lotus-eaters along the coast are the Machlyes, who also use the lotus, but less than those just mentioned. These extend as far as a great river named the Triton, which runs out into a great lake called Tritonis, in which there is an island named Phla. About this island, the Lacedaemonians say, an oracle was given them to make a settlement.
